latestCommits.message: Add quest chains and combo streaks
Add Robin C to playtester credits
Use build-time date for playtest label
Add quest log and restore original title

currentStatus.build: npm run build passed after the Field Journal changes.
currentStatus.deployment: Production deploy is ready and aliased to the custom domain.
currentStatus.liveVerification: https://grasstouchingsimulator.com returned HTTP 200 after the latest deploy.
currentStatus.git: master is pushed to origin/master. The handoff JSON itself is currently untracked unless the next session chooses to commit it.

importantContext: Keep the original title screen. The user explicitly wants the OG title screen preserved.
The user does not want offline progress.
The user likes adding systems in small, playable passes, then committing, pushing, and deploying to Vercel.
The game uses Phaser 3, TypeScript, Vite, localStorage saves, and Vercel.
Saves are browser/device localStorage only, not cloud saves.
Manual/documentation context lives in docs/PROJECT_MANUAL.md, docs/TODO.md, docs/TODO GEMINI.MD.txt, docs/GPT_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md, and docs/EMERALD_GRASS_MAGIC_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md.
Gemini/Antigravity generated visual assets and design docs in docs and public assets. Existing generated assets should be checked before creating new placeholders.

implementedToday.name: Expanded quest chains
details: Added categories such as Touching, Field, Milestones, Economy, Seed Shop, Skill Tree, Companions, and Weather.
Added prerequisiteQuestIds for chained quest pacing.
Quest Log now shows category-prefixed names and locked requirements.
Quest ready count only includes available and claimable quests.
HUD next-quest hint points to the next available quest.

implementedToday.name: Manual combo/streak system
details: Manual grass touches build combo streaks inside a 1.8s window.
Combo multipliers trigger at 5, 10, 15, 25, and 40 touches.
Combo grants bonus Grass Touches only, not seed/gold drops.
Added combo HUD badge, meter, bonus popups, threshold bursts, and slight touch-sound pitch lift.
ComboResult includes touchIntervalMs as a future hook for rhythm/on-beat mechanics.

implementedToday.name: Field Journal collection system
details: Added persistent journal state: discoveredGrassTiers, discoveredTileTraits, seenWeatherIds, and bestComboCount.
Added migration/default handling for old saves.
Existing Field Journal seed-shop purchase now unlocks a Journal button.
Journal overlay tracks grass, tile traits, weather, companions, milestone count, quest count, and best combo.
Journal button is hidden on fresh saves until field_journal is purchased.

recentlyImplementedBeforeToday: Emerald Grass Magic visual pass for core UI overlays.
Reward arcs and world-object action arcs.
Generated world/store visual objects placed on the field without scaling with board mouse zoom.
Store item icons on the left-side/world-object area.
Skill icons generated by Gemini and wired into the skill tree.
Skill tree redesigned into a Mystic Constellation style with emerald/gold framing.
Visible background tile split fixed by replacing tiled background rendering with a full-viewport generated emerald backdrop.
Starter Quest Log added with claimable rewards, ready-count cue, and persistent claimedQuestIds.
Original title screen restored after emerald pass.
Build label now uses Vite build-time date in Europe/Brussels timezone.
Robin C. added to title-screen Playtesters credits.

nextRecommendedWork.name: Rhythm/on-beat touch prototype
nextRecommendedWork.why: The user specifically mentioned wanting a future rhythm mini-game layer on top of combo. ComboSystem already exposes touchIntervalMs and manual touch flow is isolated.
firstSteps: Decide whether rhythm timing should use procedural beat ticks first or real soundtrack beat data later.
Start with a simple BeatSystem that exposes current beat phase, perfect/good/miss windows, and a HUD pulse.
Only manual touches should count for rhythm, same as combo.
risks: Title music uses HTMLAudioElement; in-game soundtrack/beat source is not yet formalized.
Avoid making rhythm required for core progression until it is fun and accessible.

nextRecommendedWork.name: Journal polish
nextRecommendedWork.why: The first pass is functional and data-driven but text-only. It could become a stronger cozy collection feature.
ideas: Add small icons or swatches for grass tiers and weather entries.
Show newly discovered journal toast when a new grass/trait/weather is recorded.
Add locked entry silhouettes or question-mark cards.
Add Field Journal quests, such as discover 3 weather types or record all traits.

nextRecommendedWork.name: Quest/milestone polish
nextRecommendedWork.why: Quest chains are now expanded, but presentation could improve as the list grows.
ideas: Add category filters/tabs in Quest Log.
Add milestone overlay or journal section with named milestone history.
Add reward burst animation at the Quest button when a quest becomes ready.
Tune rewards after user live-tests early progression.

nextRecommendedWork.name: Companion depth
nextRecommendedWork.why: Companions exist and are now tracked in the Journal. More unique companion mechanics would add identity without a huge rewrite.
ideas: Add Earthworm, Snail, or Rabbit-style mechanics if desired.
Keep companions passive first; save spatial placement for a later larger system.
Consider companion journal entries and companion quests together.

implementationNotes: Use existing Phaser text/container/button helper patterns in GameScene instead of introducing a UI framework.
Run npm run build before committing.
After visible frontend changes, use the Browser/in-app check if practical.
When deploying, use npx vercel --prod --yes and verify https://grasstouchingsimulator.com returns HTTP 200.
If adding saved fields, update GameState, createInitialState in FieldSystem.ts, SaveSystem migration/default handling, and CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION.
Keep automation from building manual combo/rhythm unless the user explicitly wants that later.
userPreferences: Tone can be casual, direct, and a little playful.
User likes pushing and deploying after meaningful batches.
User will live-test gameplay later, so automated build checks are usually enough for quick iterations unless a visual regression is likely.
Do not remove or redesign away from the OG title screen.
User is interested in a future rhythm/on-beat touching layer.
